हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: A delivery boy, Rohit, secretly a billionaire founder, hides his identity to keep his wife Manisha happy. However, her ambition and greed lead her to abort their child and grow close to her wealthy ex, Shashank. Misunderstandings, betrayal, and class conflict escalate, pushing their marriage to the brink as Rohit struggles between love and revealing his true power.
